name: eevee-film-jitter-reconstruction-alignment
purpose: Verify that Eevee updates Film reconstruction data and uniform buffers for every final-render sample so camera jitter does not leave a whole-image subpixel offset.
passCriteria: A procedural asymmetric emission triangle is rendered with 1 and 64 Eevee samples. The alpha centroid must move by less than 0.10 pixels on each axis, the 64-sample render must contain at least 500 fractional-alpha edge pixels, and alpha mass must remain within 0.5 percent. The case also writes a red/cyan overlay that makes directional edge misalignment visible.
